 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Top level - Input
 IF[Input File<br/>Upload / Link]

 %% Orchestration
 MPO[Media Pipeline Orchestration]

 IF --> MPO

 %% Symmetric left & right branches
 AP[Audio Processing]
 VP[Video Processing]

 MPO --> AP
 MPO --> VP

 %% Next level
 ST[Speech Transcription<br/>Groq / Local Whisper]
 VA[Visual Analysis<br/>Gemini]

 AP --> ST
 VP --> VA

 %% Assessment flow
 AE[Assessment Engine]
 AI[AI Assessment<br/>Rule-Based Fallback]
 RG[Report Generator]
 AR[Assessment Results<br/>Evidence & Downloadable Report]

 ST --> AE
 VA --> AE
 AE --> AI
 AI --> RG
 RG --> AR

 %% UI section
 SUI[Streamlit UI]
 User[User]

 AR --> SUI
 SUI --> User

 %% Styling
 classDef green fill:#d1fae5,stroke:#059669,stroke-width:2px
 classDef purple fill:#e9d5ff,stroke:#7c3aed,stroke-width:1.5px
 classDef orange fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706,stroke-width:1.5px
 classDef teal fill:#ccfbf1,stroke:#0d9488,stroke-width:1.5px
 classDef blue fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#2563eb,stroke-width:1.5px
 classDef gray fill:#f3f4f6,stroke:#6b7280,stroke-width:1.5px

 class IF gray
 class MPO green
 class AP,VP,ST,VA purple
 class AE,AI orange
 class RG,AR teal
 class SUI,User blue",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
